Compute Scale Scores

Source: R/score_items.R
score_items.Rd

Uses the dictionary of a tidy_sem object to compute total scores for each scale.

Usage

score_items(x, type = c("mean", "median", "sum"), ...)

Arguments

x

A tidy_sem object containing data and a dictionary with item names and scale assignments.

type

Character string specifying the scoring method. One of "mean" (default), "median", or "sum".

...

Additional arguments passed to the aggregation function, such as na.rm = TRUE.

Value

A data frame with one row per observation and one column per scale. Column names correspond to the scale names in the dictionary.

Examples

df <- iris[1:4]
names(df) <- c("x1", "x2", "y1", "y2")
model <- tidy_sem(df)
dictionary(model)$scale <- c("X", "X", "Y", "Y")
score_items(model)
